item.title: ConformTxt 0.6.31
item.description: - Word and Outlook: the font check now runs in the document itself, so a paste takes the document's font with real bullets and bold. - A plain-text paste with nothing to format no longer shows a red "Not matched" when the font can't be read. It's a normal paste. - A richer app icon: the same key and ⌘V on a deeper blue with more glass depth, matching the other utilities. The icon in About has the same depth, in your accent color.
